name: OFM-NeoPixel
description: OFM-NeoPixel is a library for the OpenKNX Framework to control LED strips. It is a high-performance LED control library for addressable RGB/RGBW/RGBCCT strips with per-strip power management and Human Centric Lighting (HCL) support.
keywords: LED, NeoPixel, WS2812, SK6812, APA102, RGBCCT, Power Management, HCL, Human Centric Lighting, RP2040, RP2350, ESP32
